description: Bundled insider-research context for one ticker in a single call — company profile, recent insider transactions (10b5-1 flagged), cluster buy/sell signals, monthly sentiment score, and a computed net buy/sell direction summary. Use this FIRST for any company insider-research question; it replaces 4 separate calls (get_company_overview, get_transactions, get_signals, get_sentiment) and degrades gracefully — if sentiment requires a plan you don't have, it comes back null with an explanatory `_unavailable` note instead of failing the whole call. Company/transaction data works on Free. Below Business, `signals` is a one-item preview (the latest cluster-buy across all companies, not necessarily this ticker), flagged with `signals_preview: true` and a `signals_unavailable` note; the full signals feed and sentiment require Business. Fetches all sections concurrently. Research and decision-support only, not investment advice.

recent_limit.description: Maximum number of recent insider transactions to include in the bundled result. Minimum 1, defaults to 10, maximum 100.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol to research, case-insensitive, e.g. AAPL. Normalized to uppercase internally.
